data.description:
GURUKRIPA BOYS PG – Comfortable and Affordable Accommodation in JP Nagar, Bengaluru

Gurukripa Boys PG, located in JP Nagar Phase 5, Bengaluru, an ideal accommodation choice for students, working professionals, and bachelors seeking a convenient and comfortable living environment. We provide well-maintained rooms, hygienic food served three times a day, high-speed Wi-Fi, study tables, washing machine facilities, geyser, individual lockers, housekeeping, and CCTV surveillance for added security. Our friendly atmosphere and essential amenities make your daily life convenient and comfortable. We offer flexible room-sharing options to suit different budgets, including six-sharing rooms at ₹6,500 per month, four-sharing rooms at ₹7,500 per month, three-sharing rooms at ₹8,500 per month, and two-sharing rooms at ₹9,500 per month. At the time of admission, a ₹2,000 maintenance charge and a ₹2,000 refundable security deposit are applicable. The security deposit is refundable when you vacate the PG, subject to the applicable conditions, and residents must provide 30 days’ advance notice before leaving to be eligible for a refund. Gurukripa PG is conveniently located near Dalmia Circle (300 metres), Dollars Colony (1 km), Nexus Vega City Mall (1.2 km), and Kalyani Magnum (1.4 km). To maintain a clean, peaceful, and disciplined environment, smoking, alcohol, and gutka are not permitted on the premises. Residents are responsible for their personal belongings, cash, gold, valuables, and health. If you plan to go out during lunch or dinner, please inform the management and arrange to have your food kept aside. Please note that no refund is provided if a resident vacates within one or two days of joining. For enquiries, room availability, or admission details, feel free to contact us by phone or WhatsApp. Choose Gurukripa Boys PG for comfortable rooms, daily meals, essential facilities, and affordable accommodation in JP Nagar, Bengaluru.
